toast.$description: Transient top-docked notification — 'Betslip loaded', 'Betslip cleared' (with an Undo), 'Quick Bet mode is active', 'Odds settings updated', 'Share link copied'. New to the system. Sits on a raised grey surface (surface.raised, so it reads above whatever it covers), with a status icon, a bold title and an optional subtitle. Optional trailing action button (Undo) and/or close ×, and an optional auto-dismiss progress bar tinted to the role. Multiple toasts stack. Roles: success (green check) · warning (gold bolt, for quick-bet) · neutral (grey). Distinct from Alert: Alert is a persistent in-flow banner tied to state; Toast is a brief, self-dismissing confirmation.

bg.$description: Raised grey — a step above a card, so the toast reads as floating over the page/sheet it covers.

border.$description: Hairline to seat it against a busy background.

gap.$description: 10px between icon, body and trailing controls.

role.$description: Status colours: the leading icon and the progress-bar tint. success = positive (green check), warning = warning (gold — the quick-bet bolt), neutral = secondary grey.

action.$description: Optional trailing action button (Undo) — the active fill, reusing Button's primary colours at a compact size.

text.$description: Dark text on the bright active fill (Pro orange).

progress.$description: Auto-dismiss timer bar along the bottom edge, tinted to the role's accent. Height is a baked 3px (not on the spacing grid — a hairline meter, not a layout step).
